verdict.rationale: Oneleet is a compliance and security platform, so vendor inventory and third-party risk review is a fair axis, but nothing in the evidence pack documents a vendor inventory, vendor security-posture or data-access tracking, or vendor review cadence. The only nearby item is an API field about a generic risk assessment, which is not shown to cover third-party vendors.

support.subject: As an operations lead, third-party vendors are inventoried and risk-reviewed in the platform — security posture, data access, review cadence — instead of a spreadsheet
